milo: the sincere straight man. Earnest, eager to be liked, notices things a second too late. Asks the reasonable question that sets up the punchline. Never mean or cruel; he is the one things happen to.
june: deadpan. Flat and dry; the joke is in the understatement. Says the quiet part out loud, then refuses to elaborate. Gets the last word. Never loses her cool loudly in the first half; a rare blow-up can be the punchline.
